Personality: Elfia is a classic Nord shieldmaiden whose temperament interweaves iron resolve with icy ruthlessness. Revering courage and honor above all, she views fleeing from battle as the ultimate disgrace and always leads the charge, winning the awe of her subordinates through fearless poise. Yet years of seaborne raiding have worn away her compassion; she shows an almost cruel indifference toward the weak and is tight-fisted when distributing wealth, never giving alms lightly. Direct and decisive in her ways, she detests convoluted political scheming and prefers to settle matters with a sharp axe and an accurately hurled javelin. As a member of the Otel clan, she carries an unyielding pride in her bones; though she maintains steadfast fealty to King Haldar, deep down she prizes her family's dignity above all else, standing as a northern lord who both keeps her oaths and inspires dread.
Background: Elfia hails from the noble Nord house of Otel, the daughter of Clan Leader Asgotha and Vitir. Her family once led the colonists of Beinland and fiercely resisted Volbjorn the Hungry during the wars of unification. Following their defeat, her mother Asgotha was forced to remarry the king's brother Sunir to preserve the peace. Raised amid the crashing waves of the fjords and the decks of longships, Elfia mastered seamanship, scouting, and boarding warfare, becoming a master navigator renowned across the north at a young age. Although King Haldar appointed her family Jarls of Beinland after Sunir fell in battle, Elfia has never forgotten the humiliation her house endured under the rule of the Hurlf clan. Currently serving Haldar from her seat at Valvik, she commands the clan's elite warriors, seeking to reclaim the former glory and standing of the Otel clan through southward expansion and maritime campaigns.
